PM/FRM/HR-JD-01.title: Job Description — Proprietor
PM/FRM/HR-JD-01.purpose: Provide strategic direction, approve the IMS and ZED policy, allocate resources and review organisational performance.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-01.appointment: Zone Leader — Z-11 Owner's Cabin. Approving Authority for all QMS documents.
Key responsibilities: Approve IMS / ZED policy and organisational objectives.
Chair the Management Review Meeting at the planned frequency.
Allocate manpower, machine, material and financial resources.
Approve new suppliers and disqualify poor performers.
Review customer satisfaction and major CAPA.
Ensure legal and statutory compliance of the establishment.
Authority: Final approval of all QMS/EHS documents.
Capital expenditure and recruitment approval.
Stop-work authority on any safety or quality risk.
Competence required: Business and manufacturing experience.
Working knowledge of ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 and ZED requirements.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-02.title: Job Description — Plant In-charge
PM/FRM/HR-JD-02.purpose: Coordinate the integrated management system, internal audits, ZED activities and overall plant compliance.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-02.appointment: Zone Leader — Z-01, Z-03, Z-12, Z-20. Internal Auditor; Safety Officer.
Key responsibilities: Maintain and revise IMS documentation — manual, procedures, formats, records.
Plan and conduct internal audits across all departments; track NC closure.
Convene the MRM — agenda, attendance, minutes, action tracking.
Monitor all KPIs in PM/FRM/MR-14 against target and escalate shortfalls.
Maintain the risk register and HIRA; review at defined frequency.
Coordinate ZED Gold certification evidence and submissions.
Act as Safety Officer, Compliance Officer and EHS Manager.
Authority: Raise and close non-conformances.
Issue and withdraw controlled documents.
Stop-work authority on safety non-compliance.
Competence required: Knowledge of ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001, ZED parameters and internal auditing.
Legal register and statutory compliance awareness.
Performance indicators: KPI review issued by 7th of each month

PM/FRM/HR-JD-03.title: Job Description — Manager / Management Representative
PM/FRM/HR-JD-03.purpose: Run production and operations to plan, and act as Management Representative for the quality management system.
Key responsibilities: Plan and control production against the customer schedule.
Ensure SOP and control-plan adherence at every stage.
Drive reduction of in-process rejection and rework PPM.
Ensure operators are trained and the skill matrix is current.
Represent the QMS to top management and to external auditors.
Lead the 5S programme across the zones under his control.
Act as Chief Fire Warden.
Authority: Release or hold production output.
Authorise rework and disposition of non-conforming product.
Deploy manpower across lines and shifts.
Competence required: Packaging and filling process knowledge.
QMS awareness, problem solving, people management.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-04.title: Job Description — Department In-charge — Production & Operations
PM/FRM/HR-JD-04.purpose: Supervise shop-floor execution, output, quality and discipline on the line.
Key responsibilities: Achieve daily production output against plan, shift-wise.
Record in-process rejection and rework and act on trends.
Carry out line clearance before every batch changeover.
Conduct shift handover and manpower deployment.
Enforce PPE use and safe working practice on the floor.
Report any breakdown or abnormality to Maintenance immediately.
Raise at least one Kaizen per month.
Authority: Halt the line on a quality or safety abnormality.
Reallocate operators between stations within the shift.
Competence required: Machine and process knowledge, 5S, basic quality tools.
Ability to read the production plan and record data accurately.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-05.title: Job Description — Department In-charge — Stores
PM/FRM/HR-JD-05.purpose: Control receipt, storage, preservation and issue of all materials.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-05.appointment: Zone Supervisor — Z-02, Z-09, Z-15, Z-19, Z-25, Z-26.
Key responsibilities: Maintain min-max levels and raise indents in time.
Enforce FIFO; prevent issue of expired or shelf-life-exceeded material.
Conduct monthly stock audit — physical against system.
Ensure GRN and incoming documentation is complete for every receipt.
Display MSDS for all chemicals stored.
Compile supplier rating monthly and maintain the Approved Supplier List.
Raise CAPA to suppliers on quality failure.
Authority: Reject incoming material not meeting specification.
Hold and quarantine suspect stock.
Competence required: Stores and inventory practice, FIFO, material identification.
Chemical handling and MSDS awareness.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-06.title: Job Description — Department In-charge — Dispatch & Logistics
PM/FRM/HR-JD-06.purpose: Deliver finished goods on the confirmed date with complete and accurate documentation.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-06.appointment: Zone Supervisor — Z-03, Z-04, Z-08, Z-23, Z-24. KRAs transferred from the former Head — Dispatch & Logistics.
Key responsibilities: Achieve on-time dispatch for every confirmed delivery date.
Compile schedule-versus-dispatch data customer-wise with reasons for shortfall.
Raise CAPA for every delayed dispatch.
Maintain FIFO in the finished goods and dispatch area.
Issue the daily shortage report against the customer schedule.
Verify DC, invoice, packing list and e-way bill on every dispatch.
Inspect the vehicle for cleanliness and fitness before loading.
Track logistics cost against budget.
Authority: Hold a dispatch on incomplete documentation or an unfit vehicle.
Approve transporter selection within the approved panel.
Competence required: Dispatch documentation, e-way bill and transport practice.
FIFO and finished goods handling.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-07.title: Job Description — Department In-charge — Maintenance
PM/FRM/HR-JD-07.purpose: Keep plant and utilities available, calibrated and energy-efficient.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-07.appointment: Zone Leader — Z-07 Pump Room, Z-21 Maintenance Area; Zone Supervisor — Z-20.
Key responsibilities: Execute the preventive maintenance schedule and record adherence.
Keep machine breakdown hours within target; track MTTR and MTBF.
Raise CAPA for machines under frequent breakdown.
Maintain the calibration plan; ensure stickers and certificates are current.
Record daily electricity readings and monitor power factor.
Control maintenance spares and repair cost.
Raise at least one Kaizen per month on breakdown or energy loss.
Authority: Take a machine out of service for safety or condition reasons.
Authorise emergency spare purchase within limit.
Competence required: Mechanical and electrical maintenance of packaging / filling machinery.
Calibration practice; electrical safety.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-08.title: Job Description — Department In-charge — Office, HR & Purchase
PM/FRM/HR-JD-08.purpose: Run HR, training, statutory compliance and purchase support, and control QMS documents.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-08.appointment: Zone Leader — Z-14, Z-16, Z-18, Z-27; Zone Supervisor — Z-10, Z-12, Z-13. Document Controller.
Key responsibilities: Conduct induction for every new joiner within the first week.
Prepare and execute the annual training plan; evaluate effectiveness.
Maintain the skill matrix and update it at the defined frequency.
Maintain job descriptions and the organisation chart; revise on any change.
Handle leave, payroll coordination and statutory compliance (PF / ESIC).
Raise and follow up purchase orders against approved indents.
Act as Document Controller for the QMS.
Coordinate and document CSR activity.
Authority: Issue and withdraw controlled copies of QMS documents.
Release purchase orders within approved limit.
Competence required: HR administration, statutory compliance, document control.
Purchase and vendor coordination.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-09.title: Job Description — Department In-charge — Quality Assurance & Admin
PM/FRM/HR-JD-09.purpose: Assure incoming, in-process and outgoing product quality and maintain quality records.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-09.appointment: Zone Leader — Z-10, Z-13; Zone Supervisor — Z-11, Z-14.
Key responsibilities: Complete incoming inspection (IQC) records lot-wise.
Complete outgoing inspection (OQC) records batch-wise before dispatch.
Track gauge and instrument calibration adherence.
Register customer complaints and drive CAPA to closure.
Control quality documents and retain records per the retention schedule.
Arrange in-house and third-party product test reports.
Support internal quality audits and track NC closure.
Control visitor entry and gate passes.
Authority: Reject or hold non-conforming material or product.
Stop dispatch where OQC records are incomplete.
Competence required: Inspection and testing methods, measuring instruments.
Documentation and record control.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-10.title: Job Description — Machine Operator
PM/FRM/HR-JD-10.purpose: Operate an assigned machine safely and to specification, and record output accurately.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-10.appointment: Assigned to a machine by the Department In-charge; recorded in the skill matrix.
Key responsibilities: Operate the assigned filling / packing / printing machine per the SOP.
Carry out start-up checks and line clearance before every batch.
Check weight, seal, coding and labelling at the defined frequency.
Segregate rejection and rework at source; never mix with good stock.
Record production, rejection and downtime on the shift record.
Stop the machine and inform the In-charge on any abnormality.
Keep the workstation to 5S standard and wear the specified PPE.
Authority: Stop the machine on a quality or safety abnormality.
Competence required: Trained on the specific machine and its SOP; able to record data.
5S and PPE awareness; basic quality checks.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-11.title: Job Description — Worker
PM/FRM/HR-JD-11.purpose: Carry out assigned packing, filling and handling work to standard.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-11.appointment: Designation confirmed by the department head; recorded in the employee master.
Key responsibilities: Perform the assigned packing / filling / labelling operation per the SOP.
Handle material without damage or contamination.
Segregate rejection and rework as instructed.
Follow FIFO in staging and buffer areas.
Keep the work area clean and to 5S standard; wear the specified PPE.
Report any unsafe condition or abnormality to the In-charge.
Authority: Stop work and report any unsafe condition.
Competence required: On-the-job trained for the assigned operation.
5S, hygiene and PPE awareness.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-12.title: Job Description — Helper
PM/FRM/HR-JD-12.purpose: Support the line with material movement, cleaning and handling.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-12.appointment: Designation confirmed by the department head; recorded in the employee master.
Key responsibilities: Move raw material, packing material and finished goods as instructed.
Support machine operators with feeding and stacking.
Carry out cleaning of the area and equipment as scheduled.
Assist in loading, unloading and scrap removal.
Follow safe manual handling practice and wear the specified PPE.
Authority: Stop work and report any unsafe condition.
Competence required: Safe manual handling; awareness of the material being handled.
5S and hygiene awareness.

PM/FRM/HR-JD-13.title: Job Description — Security Guard
PM/FRM/HR-JD-13.purpose: Control entry and exit of people, vehicles and material at the gate.
PM/FRM/HR-JD-13.appointment: Zone Supervisor — Z-01 Security + Meter Room. Engaged through a labour contractor.
Key responsibilities: Record every visitor, vehicle and contractor entry and exit.
Verify the gate pass for all outgoing material.
Check incoming vehicles before allowing entry to the loading area.
Maintain the keys and the gate register; hand over at shift change.
Raise alarm and follow the emergency plan on any incident.
Keep the gate and meter room area to 5S standard.
Authority: Refuse entry where authorisation or documentation is absent.
Competence required: Gate control, visitor and material movement recording.
Emergency response and fire alarm awareness.
